title: The Papers: UK-made drones 'strike Russia' and 'phone theft Britain'
originalTitle: The Papers: UK-made drones 'strike Russia' and 'phone theft Britain'
content:
A plan for water companies to be able to charge consumers higher prices during drought, externals is the lead for the Sunday Telegraph.

The paper reports that, pending regulatory approval, firms could be allowed to introduce prices that change based on the time of year, and factor "water scarcity" into bills as part of a way to reduce consumption.

The Sunday Times reports that British drones supplied to Ukraine, external have been used to strike targets on the Russian mainland for the first time.

The paper says sources in the Ukrainian armed forces have confirmed the use of the weapons over the past six months, as part of Kyiv's deep-strike campaign.

The Mail on Sunday says the government's wildfire alert, which was sent to mobile phones on Friday night, caused chaos, external.

The paper says the 999 switchboard was "swamped" by people in a panic and that the "unexpected" alert caused startled drivers to swerve on motorways.
